headline: Ghana Remains Exposed to Commodity Price Volatility, IMF Says
summary: The IMF noted that Ghana remains exposed to volatility in gold, cocoa, and oil prices, while authorities have taken corrective actions on foreign exchange reserves.
why: IMF program evaluations provide critical benchmarks for sovereign debt sustainability and macroeconomic stability in developing nations.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Exposure to commodity price fluctuations impacts national fiscal performance and reserves.
